question: Which of the following is a symptom of bacterial infection?
solution:
The correct answer is__** fever.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Fever is a common symptom of bacterial infection as the body's immune system responds to the presence of bacteria by raising the internal temperature.**
 
• ** Other symptoms of bacterial infection may include fatigue, muscle aches, and chills.**
 
• Bacterial infections can be** treated with antibiotics,** but it is important to identify the specific bacteria causing the infection to ensure the right medication is prescribed.
 
• If left untreated, bacterial infections can lead to more serious complications such as sepsis or organ failure.
 
• Bacteria that can cause disease are known as pathogenic bacteria.
 
• Pathogens can spread through the air, skin contact, bodily fluids, etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Cardiac arrest, fracture, and heart attack are not symptoms of bacterial infection. Cardiac arrest is a sudden loss of heart function, while a fracture is a break in a bone and a heart attack occurs when blood flow to the heart is blocked, typically due to a buildup of plaque in the arteries.
 
• However, bacterial infections can sometimes lead to complications that affect the heart or other organs.
 
• For example, untreated streptococcal infections can cause rheumatic fever, which can damage the heart valves.
 
• It is important to seek medical attention if you suspect you have a bacterial infection, as prompt treatment can prevent serious complications.
